heading: EXT. CIVIC PLAZA - CLIMATE MARCH - DAY

units.text: EXT. CIVIC PLAZA - CLIMATE MARCH - DAY
A river of cardboard signs.
Drums.
A bullhorn SQUEALS and dies.
Three thousand people, one bank across the square, and nobody looking at the loading dock. That's the whole trick. Be loud somewhere else.
units.name: RENA

units.text: RENA (30s, green vest, laminated MARSHAL badge) walks against the crowd, while BEA (20s, same vest, clipboard) cuts through the PROTESTERS ahead of her, a backpack riding high on her shoulders, and above them both a banner reading THERE IS NO PLANET B snaps in the wind as a helicopter's rotor THUMPS somewhere over the glass towers.
Pay for it! Pay for it! Pay for it!
units.name: PROTESTERS

units.text: Rena catches up.
Bea doesn't slow.
You're early.
units.name: RENA

units.text: You're late. She said two-ten.
units.name: BEA

units.text: She said two-fifteen.
units.name: RENA

units.text: She said whatever gets us paid.
units.name: BEA

units.text: A cardboard polar bear bobs between them.
Bea ducks it.
Rena doesn't.
Bea never trusted a plan she didn't write. Which was fair. She wrote this one.
units.name: RENA

units.text: A whistle SHRIEKS.
Police on bikes line the east side of the plaza.
Bea steers Rena by the elbow toward the alley behind the bank.
Badge.
units.name: BEA

units.text: On.
units.name: RENA

units.text: Truck?
units.name: BEA

units.text: Ten minutes out. She's driving.
units.name: RENA

units.text: Bea stops short.
Stares at her.
She's driving? She said she'd be here.
units.name: BEA

units.text: She's here. I mean she's close. She's in the truck. Bea, she's fine.
units.name: RENA

units.text: Pay for it! Pay for it!
units.name: PROTESTERS

units.text: A speaker on the stage starts a speech.
The crowd ROARS.
Bea uses the noise and cracks the service gate with a bolt cutter.
The lock CLANKS onto the pavement.
Then she's late and she's here. Pick one.
units.name: BEA

units.text: Forty seconds to the dock. Four minutes inside. Everybody on that square would remember the speech and nobody the van.
units.name: RENA

units.text: They slip through.
The gate CLANGS shut behind them.
The chanting drops to a muffled pulse.
